_comment: Multi-project capable: every MCP tool accepts an optional project_path parameter pointing to a directory containing graphify-out/graph.json. To pin a single workspace graph by default, pass ["<REPO_ROOT>/graphify-out/graph.json"] in args or set cwd to <REPO_ROOT>. Alternative invocation without global PATH: command="uv", args=["run", "--with", "graphifyy[mcp]", "-m", "graphify.serve"].
